apps.name: Genius! Iranian Edition
apps.subtitle: Iranian history, politics, and culture as a quiz show.
apps.localizedDescription:
A bilingual Iranian quiz show with Single and Double Genius, Daily Doubles, Final Genius, local music, and 6,051 sourced clues in each language.

The IPA is unsigned. SideStore, AltStore, or another sideloading tool signs it with your own Apple ID.
apps.versionDescription: Version 2.1.0 adds 1,884 brand-new source-verified bilingual clues (3,768 EN+FA entries) across Iranian pop culture, music, cinema, fashion, literature, and history (6,051 clues per language) and trims unused legacy assets.

versions.localizedDescription: Adds 1,884 brand-new bilingual clues (6,051 per language across 1,298 categories) covering Iranian pop culture, music, cinema, fashion, Shahnameh, and frontier historical scholarship, plus legacy asset cleanup.
Rebrands to GENIUS! (نابغه!) with restored transparent logos, 22 cloned course host clips, Final Genius audio, an overhauled phone layout, and zero-scroll opening screens.
Opens the studio door on the files it is waiting for, and plays with no network at all.
